name: Nevus of Ito

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical diagnosis of Nevus of Ito

criteria.description: Presence of blue to gray-brown macular pigmentation over the shoulder and upper arm region
Congenital or early childhood onset of pigmentation
Histological confirmation showing dermal melanocytosis without epidermal involvement

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic pigmentation in typical anatomical distribution with congenital or early childhood onset
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical; biopsy is rarely required unless malignancy is suspected
